# uniq

Filter adjacent duplicate records through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/uniq input.txt

moonx cli/uniq -c input.txt
```

Compare adjacent records, optionally skipping fields or bytes. Use sort first when equal records are not already adjacent.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--count` | Prefix each record with its occurrence count. |
| `-d`, `--repeated` | Print only repeated records. |
| `-u`, `--unique` | Print only groups that occur once. |
| `-i`, `--ignore-case` | Ignore ASCII case when comparing adjacent records. |
| `-f VALUE`, `--skip-fields VALUE` | Skip fields, then bytes before comparing. Default: `0`. |
| `-s VALUE`, `--skip-chars VALUE` | Skip fields, then bytes before comparing. Default: `0`. |
| `-z`, `--zero-terminated` | Use NUL-delimited records. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

- Field handling and case folding use C-locale byte semantics.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
